verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat kar saadhanaa piram piaalaa ajar jaranaa|

en.bdb: Adopting the discipline in the holy congregation, the unbearable cup of love is drunk and endured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਮਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai jeeva(n)dhiaa maranaa|

en.bdb: Then the individual falling at the feet and eschewing ego dies in relation to all the worldly concerns.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਤਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: jeevan mukat vakhaaneeaai mar mar jeevan ddub ddub taranaa|

en.bdb: Liberated in life is he who dies of maya and lives up in the love of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਤੈ ਅਉਚਰ ਚਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat livaleen hoi apio peean tai aauchar charanaa|

en.bdb: Merging his consciousness in Word and quaffing the nectar he eats up his ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: anahadh naadh aves kar a(n)mirat vaanee nijhar jharanaa|

en.bdb: Inspired by the unstruck melody he always goes on pouring the word-nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣ ਨ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: karan kaaran samarath hoi kaaran karan na kaaran karanaa|

en.bdb: Now he is already cause of all the causes but still does nothing harmful to others.
Such a person salvages the sinners and provides shelter to the shelterless.
